test_gtn_equal: test two gtn Graph objects for structural equality including nodes, arcs, labels, and weights
test_gtn_isomorphic: test whether two gtn Graph objects are isomorphic ignoring node ordering but respecting arc multiplicity
test_gtn_loadtxt_savetxt: test loading and saving gtn Graph objects to and from plain text format files
test_gtn_save_load: test saving and loading gtn Graph objects to and from binary format files
test_gtn_graph_construction: test building gtn Graph objects with add_node and add_arc including start, accept, and epsilon arcs
